lessons.key: ac_gap::when a spec ac asks for an unconditional summary e g how is my budget doing alongside a conditional filtered variant e g what needs attention implement both as distinct handlers don t assume the filtered one satisfies the unconditional one
lessons.text: When a spec AC asks for an unconditional summary (e.g. 'how is my budget doing') alongside a conditional/filtered variant (e.g. 'what needs attention'), implement both as distinct handlers — don't assume the filtered one satisfies the unconditional one.

lessons.key: ac_gap::a routing threshold function being unit tested in isolation does not mean it s reachable verify the graph router edge actually passes the field e g confidence the function needs not just that the function behaves correctly when called directly
lessons.text: A routing/threshold function being unit-tested in isolation does not mean it's reachable — verify the graph/router edge actually passes the field (e.g. confidence) the function needs, not just that the function behaves correctly when called directly.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a spec ac requires citing a source collection doc in a user facing reply test the final response text metadata for that citation testing only that retrieval happened is not sufficient evidence
lessons.text: When a spec AC requires citing a source (collection+doc) in a user-facing reply, test the final response text/metadata for that citation — testing only that retrieval happened is not sufficient evidence.

lessons.key: ac_gap::a fallback adapter function being fully unit tested does not prove it s wired into the real startup path grep for its call sites in application code not just tests before marking the ac done
lessons.text: A fallback/adapter function being fully unit-tested does not prove it's wired into the real startup path — grep for its call sites in application code (not just tests) before marking the AC done.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when an edge case specifies preserving state across a redirect e g return url assert the actual query param header in the test not just the redirect target path
lessons.text: When an edge case specifies preserving state across a redirect (e.g. return URL), assert the actual query param/header in the test, not just the redirect target path.
